newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Jan-Feb media gross ad revs rise 3.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: German Jan-Feb media gross ad revs rise 3.7 pct.

text.p: Gross advertising revenues for the major media segments rose 3.7 percent in the first two months of 1997 from the same period a year ago, the IPA Plus media agency said on Thursday.

The agency, publishing data provided by Dun and Bradstreet's Nielsen research unit, gave the following details in its latest report covering 1997 advertising revenue to the end of February. (All figures in millions of marks unless stated.)

NOTE - The data do not include direct mail, listings magazines, or newspaper supplements.
